sections.domain: Speed, stops, turns and right of way
sections.heading: C2 — Speed, stops, turns and right of way
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Speed, stops, turns and right of way

FACT_ID: sec08-R01 | anchor: A72
Use a turn signal when changing lanes or passing another vehicle. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R02 | anchor: A72
Use a turn signal when leaving a roundabout. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R03 | anchor: A72
Signal a turn at an intersection or into a driveway. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R04 | anchor: A72
Use a turn signal when entering or leaving a freeway or interstate highway. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R05 | anchor: A72
Signal when pulling from a parked roadside position into the traffic lane. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R06 | anchor: A72
Signal before pulling over to the side of the road. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R07 | anchor: A72
In a business or residential area, signal at least one hundred feet before a turn or lane change, except that a turn just beyond an intersection is signaled after passing through it. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R08 | anchor: A72
On a freeway or highway, signal at least five seconds before a turn or lane change, except that a turn just beyond an intersection is signaled after passing through it. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R09 | anchor: A72
For a turn planned just beyond an intersection, signal after going through that intersection to avoid confusing other drivers. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R10 | anchor: A72
A driver may use electric turn signals or arm signals. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R11 | anchor: A72
Extending the arm and hand straight out the window signals a left turn. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R12 | anchor: A72
Extending the arm and hand upward out the window signals a right turn. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R13 | anchor: A72
Extending the arm and hand downward out the window signals slowing or stopping. [A72]
Source: [A72 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0072]

FACT_ID: sec08-R14 | anchor: A73
For a right turn, signal and approach in the right lane as close to the curb as reasonably possible. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R15 | anchor: A73
Before turning right, yield to pedestrians and vehicles that have the right of way. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R16 | anchor: A73
Before turning right, watch for bicycles approaching between the vehicle's right side and the curb. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R17 | anchor: A73
Complete a right turn into the cross street's right lane without swinging wide. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R18 | anchor: A73
For a left turn, signal and approach in the farthest-left lane open to traffic moving in the driver's direction. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R19 | anchor: A73
On a two-lane road, a driver preparing to turn left should move to the left side of the current lane. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R20 | anchor: A73
Before a left turn, yield to pedestrians and oncoming vehicles. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R21 | anchor: A73
When safe, complete a left turn into the nearest lane carrying traffic in the intended direction without cutting the corner. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R22 | anchor: A73
At a steady red light, a right turn may be made after stopping and yielding to cross-traffic and pedestrians with the right of way, unless signs prohibit the turn. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R23 | anchor: A73
A left turn from a one-way street onto another one-way street may be made on steady red after stopping and yielding to cross-traffic and pedestrians, unless posted otherwise. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R24 | anchor: A73
A posted No U-turn sign prohibits making a U-turn. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R25 | anchor: A73
Do not make a U-turn on a curve or near or approaching a hillcrest where approaching drivers from either direction cannot see the vehicle within five hundred feet. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R26 | anchor: A73
A U-turn is prohibited in a no-passing zone. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R27 | anchor: A73
Stop and yield to all traffic before completing a U-turn. [A73]
Source: [A73 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0073]

FACT_ID: sec08-R28 | anchor: A74
Solid markings in the road's center indicate that a U-turn is prohibited. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R29 | anchor: A74
For a permitted U-turn using the handbook's procedure, first move to the far-right edge of the road and stop. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R30 | anchor: A74
In the handbook’s U-turn procedure, check ahead, behind and the blind spot to the left rear; if the path is clear, signal and steer sharply left at low speed. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R31 | anchor: A74
Once the vehicle points in the intended direction during the stated U-turn procedure, check behind again and accelerate to traffic speed. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R32 | anchor: A74
The general keep-right rule has stated exceptions for left-turn preparation, same-direction passing, a designated slow-traffic lane on a highway with more than two lanes, temporary hazard avoidance, one-way roads and multiple same-direction lanes. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R33 | anchor: A74
Preparing for a left turn is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R34 | anchor: A74
Passing another vehicle traveling in the same direction is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R35 | anchor: A74
The keep-far-right rule has an exception on a highway with more than two lanes when the right lane is designated for slow traffic. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R36 | anchor: A74
Temporarily entering the left lane to avoid an obstruction, pedestrian or animal is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R37 | anchor: A74
A road restricted to one-way traffic is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R38 | anchor: A74
A road with at least two lanes moving in the same direction is an exception to the general keep-far-right rule. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R39 | anchor: A74
The handbook describes right of way as something drivers give rather than take. [A74]
Source: [A74 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0074]

FACT_ID: sec08-R40 | anchor: A75
Motor vehicles must yield to a pedestrian within a marked or unmarked intersection crosswalk. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R41 | anchor: A75
A vehicle entering a street from an alley or driveway must yield to pedestrians. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R42 | anchor: A75
Motor vehicles must yield to a blind pedestrian walking with a white cane or a guide dog. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R43 | anchor: A75
A pedestrian crossing away from both a crosswalk and an intersection must yield to motor vehicles. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R44 | anchor: A75
A pedestrian must yield to motor vehicles when an intersection or crosswalk signal directs that yielding. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R45 | anchor: A75
When approaching a Yield sign, slow down, be ready to stop and yield to other drivers. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R46 | anchor: A75
After stopping to enter a street from an alley, driveway or garage, yield to other drivers. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R47 | anchor: A75
After stopping at a two-way stop, yield to cross-traffic. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R48 | anchor: A75
At a four-way stop, the first vehicle to arrive has the right of way. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R49 | anchor: A75
If two vehicles reach a four-way stop together, the vehicle on the left must yield to the one on the right. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R50 | anchor: A75
At an intersection with no signs or signals, simultaneous arrivals require the driver on the left to yield to the driver on the right. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

FACT_ID: sec08-R51 | anchor: A75
At an uncontrolled T-intersection where the driver must turn left or right, the handbook requires stopping, yielding, or both for traffic approaching from the other two directions. [A75]
Source: [A75 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0075]

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page sixty-nine describes turning left onto a one-way street without the origin condition, while page seventy-three specifies a one-way origin and destination. Only the narrower explicit case is authored; broader origin eligibility remains unresolved.

The left-lane/right-lane movement paragraph on physical page seventy-three is tied to an unreviewed diagram. Its unspecified junction layout is not generalized into permission to turn left from any right lane; visual/layout evidence remains required.
